objects.name: monitor_results_daily_delete
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER monitor_results_daily_delete AFTER DELETE ON monitor_results BEGIN UPDATE monitor_daily_results SET
      checks_total = checks_total - (CASE WHEN OLD.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
      checks_up = checks_up - (CASE WHEN OLD.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 0 WHEN OLD.status = 'up' OR OLD.unconfirmed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      maintenance_checks = maintenance_checks - (CASE WHEN OLD.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      response_sum = response_sum - (coalesce(OLD.response_ms, 0)),
      response_count = response_count - (CASE WHEN OLD.response_ms IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
    WHERE monitor_id = OLD.monitor_id AND day = OLD.checked_at / 86400000; END

objects.name: monitor_results_daily_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER monitor_results_daily_insert AFTER INSERT ON monitor_results BEGIN INSERT INTO monitor_daily_results (monitor_id, day, checks_total, checks_up, maintenance_checks, response_sum, response_count)
    VALUES (NEW.monitor_id, NEW.checked_at / 86400000, CASE WHEN NEW.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN NEW.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 0 WHEN NEW.status = 'up' OR NEW.unconfirmed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN NEW.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, coalesce(NEW.response_ms, 0), CASE WHEN NEW.response_ms IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
    ON CONFLICT (monitor_id, day) DO UPDATE SET
      checks_total = checks_total + excluded.checks_total,
      checks_up = checks_up + excluded.checks_up,
      maintenance_checks = maintenance_checks + excluded.maintenance_checks,
      response_sum = response_sum + excluded.response_sum,
      response_count = response_count + excluded.response_count; END

objects.name: monitor_results_daily_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER monitor_results_daily_update AFTER UPDATE OF monitor_id, checked_at, status, unconfirmed, response_ms ON monitor_results
   BEGIN UPDATE monitor_daily_results SET
      checks_total = checks_total - (CASE WHEN OLD.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
      checks_up = checks_up - (CASE WHEN OLD.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 0 WHEN OLD.status = 'up' OR OLD.unconfirmed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      maintenance_checks = maintenance_checks - (CASE WHEN OLD.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
      response_sum = response_sum - (coalesce(OLD.response_ms, 0)),
      response_count = response_count - (CASE WHEN OLD.response_ms IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
    WHERE monitor_id = OLD.monitor_id AND day = OLD.checked_at / 86400000; INSERT INTO monitor_daily_results (monitor_id, day, checks_total, checks_up, maintenance_checks, response_sum, response_count)
    VALUES (NEW.monitor_id, NEW.checked_at / 86400000, CASE WHEN NEW.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN NEW.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 0 WHEN NEW.status = 'up' OR NEW.unconfirmed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN NEW.unconfirmed = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, coalesce(NEW.response_ms, 0), CASE WHEN NEW.response_ms IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
    ON CONFLICT (monitor_id, day) DO UPDATE SET
      checks_total = checks_total + excluded.checks_total,
      checks_up = checks_up + excluded.checks_up,
      maintenance_checks = maintenance_checks + excluded.maintenance_checks,
      response_sum = response_sum + excluded.response_sum,
      response_count = response_count + excluded.response_count; END
